title: Issues with nu 0.78
body:

nu 0.78 introduced some breaking changes, and now I'm getting this error:

`  × Missing || inside closure
    ╭─[init.nu:8:1]
  8 │     
  9 │ ╭─▶ let-env PROMPT_COMMAND = {
 10 │ │       # jobs are not supported
 11 │ │       let width = (term size).columns
 12 │ │       ^/home/x/.cargo/bin/starship prompt $"--cmd-duration=($env.CMD_DURATION_MS)" $"--status=($env.LAST_EXIT_CODE)" $"--terminal-width=($width)"
 13 │ ├─▶ }
    · ╰──── Parsing as a closure, but || is missing
 14 │     
    ╰────
  help: Try add || to the beginning of closure`?

as far as I know, the init.nu is temp, so I can not modify it...?

comments.author: participant1
reporter
comments.body:
how?

When I change my init.nu (~/.cache/starship/init.nu)

the changed values are overwritten on nu start

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Edit  `~/.cache/starship/init.nu` the file as @participant1 said and comment out 
```bash
starship init nu | save -f ~/.cache/starship/init.nu
```

Mind that this works for now, they already have changed the code inside `src/init/starship.nu`, they need to release a new version, but keep an eye out when they release the update to uncomment the line.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
As a temporary fix, to avoid editing the `init.nu` directly, you can update your `env.nu` with the following:

```shell
starship init nu
| str replace --string 'PROMPT_COMMAND = {' 'PROMPT_COMMAND = { ||'
| str replace --string 'PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT = {' 'PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT = { ||'
| save -f ~/.cache/starship/init.nu
```

This replaces the string returned from `starship init nu` to account for the latest changes.

comments.author: participant6
comments.body:
For anyone that's installed starship/nu with Nix using `home-manager`, using the provided `programs.nushell.envFile.text` option to configure the `env.nu` file results in the `starship init nu | save ...` line being appended onto the end of the file, if `programs.starship.enableNushellIntegration` is set to true. The current workaround I'm using for this is to explicitly set the contents of the `env.nu` with the above solution by doing:
```nix
xdg.configFile."nushell/env.nu".text = ''
  # ...
  starship init nu
  | str replace --string 'PROMPT_COMMAND = {' 'PROMPT_COMMAND = { ||'
  | str replace --string 'PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT = {' 'PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT = { ||'
  | save -f ~/.cache/starship/init.nu
''
```
